title: Transcriptome sequencing of PMN derived from the TAO group, GD group, and NC group
description: The research subjects we included were divided into three groups: the Thyroid-associated ophthalmopathy (TAO) group, the Graves' disease (GD) group, and the normal control (NC) group. The research subjects in the TAO group met the international Bartly diagnostic criteria. The diagnosis of GD patients needed to meet the diagnostic criteria for Graves' disease in the Chinese Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Thyroid Diseases, and they had no any ocular symptoms. The NC group needed to have no history of thyroid diseases and ocular diseases. Then, we performed transcriptome sequencing on Polymorphonuclear neutrophils (PMN) from 10 TAO patients, 5 GD patients, and 9 NC subjects to obtain the gene expression profiles of PMN from each group.
